scenarios.name: exiled-card-deals-damage-at-end-step
scenarios.why: A land entering under the controller's control exiles a card, so a card remains exiled with Valakut Exploration at end step; the ability deals one damage to each opponent.

scenarios.name: no-exiled-cards-no-end-step-trigger
scenarios.why: No card has been exiled with Valakut Exploration, so its end-step condition is false and its damage ability does not trigger.
